description: Transactional outbox for DotCourier on EF Core: notifications are stored in the same transaction as your data and delivered afterwards, at least once, by a background processor.
Client for the FedEx Basic Integrated Visibility (formerly Track API) REST API: OAuth token caching, typed requests and responses, and dependency injection support.
Run Respire operations through Polly v8 resilience pipelines with one command retry owner.
Authorized ASP.NET Core operator dashboard for Redis streams and reliable job queues.
Delivers DotCourier's transactional outbox to Kafka: the stored events are published to topics (acks=all, idempotent producer) instead of the in-process handlers, so other services can consume them.
